title: Yang–Mills Existence & Mass Gap
summary: Constructive lattice gauge theory in Lean 4 paired with reproducible SU(2)/SU(3) lattice Monte Carlo glueball mass bounds.
honesty_statement: A volunteer swarm of language models will not solve the Millennium Prize problem outright. Track A builds machine-checked Lean 4 foundations of constructive lattice gauge theory; Track B produces reproducible lattice Monte Carlo numerical evidence for the 0++ glueball mass gap. The word Solved never appears.
